item.title: The Unrune (For Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): Standard SCP layout followed by information on where the object was recovered from and the groups connected with it. Possible addendums or test logs will tie in more of the important story

Elevator Pitch: A rune stone that defies physics, disobeys logic, and removes any sense of comfort. According to all attempts to gather data, it doesn't exist, yet we perceive it with our senses. However the rune engraved on it can only be seen, not felt, and in any image of the object it is blank.

Central Narrative: A cult worshipping the god of chaos believes this rune stone imprisons him and it is their duty to set him free once more. The GOC ended up with it, tried to destroy it and couldn't, and decided to give it to the foundation since containing is more their speed. The rune isn't what the cult thinks, but there's more to it than the foundation knows and it ties into a larger story relating to this so called god and his cult.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The object defies reality and physics and is tied to some god, but isn't really dangerous or powerful. It's more focused on the story I want to introduce but a reality defying object that doesn't do much and a god that isn't a god might be refreshing amongst the massive distortions and apocalyptic deities.

Additional Notes: This IS NOT meant to be some new all powerful, world ending, eldritch being. I don't want to make this about yet another god who wants to destroy humanity. I'm starting small, with this rune, so I don't come across like it's my goal to top anybody else or "have the baddest scp". Just want some cool ideas and a good story because that's what I personally love.
